name: sol-advisor
description: Codex-native selective routing with temporary runtime storage and configurable independent Reviewer rounds.

interface.shortDescription: Selective delivery with temporary state and independent Reviewer rounds.
interface.longDescription: Sol Advisor keeps architecture, scheduling, decisions, and acceptance with the root. Before work begins, it declares a SELECTIVE ROUTE and one shared acceptance basis. Solo is default; delegate uses one implementer; audit/full default to two independent fresh read-only Reviewers per round, with any positive user override. Root aggregates evidence without majority voting or automatic extra Reviewers. Full retains exact combined candidate and immutable evidence checks that fail closed; temporary runtime storage replaces mandatory project artifact directories.
defaultPrompt: For root startup, load only skill guidance, then declare the route before other task tools; never batch loading with task discovery. Use $sol-advisor:orchestration to declare a SELECTIVE ROUTE before task tools, then build and verify this feature.
Use solo by default; select delegate, audit, or exceptional full only when the stated risk justifies it.
